title: OrderFlowProcess
description: Market-microstructure order flow as a MARKED POINT PROCESS in event time: events ARRIVE (arrival-intensity family), rest and are CANCELLED (decay / competing hazard), and are FILLED (execution / thinning conditional on queue position), each carrying a MARK (signed size). The record binds the arrival family onto the estate memory-regime taxonomy in event time and exposes two consumables BY REFERENCE: a risk_distribution_F (marks) for the economic-prophet RAROC risk kernel risk(F, kernel, reference, horizon), and LOB micro-signals (Kyle-lambda / OFI / effective volume / signed-flow Hurst) for market_instruments.liquidity_premium(volume, regime_hurst, base_bps). Consume-not-fork: the regime labels, the risk_distribution_F shape, and the SHA-256 receipt are the memory-mesh MemoryRegimeCharacterization contract's, reused not redefined.

inputDescriptor.description: What was characterized: an observed event stream (referenced) or a seeded generator (deterministic CI teeth).

n_events.description: Number of events. Below the estate min-n (30) the characterization may only be 'provisional'.

arrival.description: Arrival-intensity family and its estimated attributes. branching_ratio_n = int phi is the self-excitation strength; n>=1 is non-stationary (the flash-crash edge). index_of_dispersion (Fano factor) drives the Poisson-vs-Hawkes discrimination; counting_hurst discriminates the exponential (short) from the power-law (long-memory) kernel.

base_intensity_mu.description: Immigrant/base intensity mu. A negative intensity is refused (schema minimum).

branching_ratio_n.description: Branching ratio n = int phi. n<1 stationary; n>=1 explosive/non-stationary.

index_of_dispersion.description: Var(N)/E(N) over count windows. ~1 for Poisson; >1 under self-excitation.

duration_autocorr.description: Lag-1 autocorrelation of interarrival durations. ~0 for Poisson; strongly positive under ACD memory a Poisson fit misses.

poisson_vs_hawkes.description: Discrimination verdict: 'hawkes' when the index of dispersion shows significant excitation (a Poisson fit is refused).

stable.description: n<1. When false (n>=1) the process is non-stationary and requires explicit unstable_override.

unstable_override.description: Explicit acknowledgement required to accept an n>=1 (non-stationary) spec. Absent/false with n>=1 => refused (flash-crash guard).

decay.description: Cancellation as a COMPETING HAZARD against fill. A resting limit order's lifetime is Exp(fill_hazard + cancel_hazard); its fill probability is fill_hazard/(fill_hazard+cancel_hazard). kernel_decay is the Hawkes excitation decay (beta for exponential, gamma for power-law).

execution.description: Fills as a THINNING of the arrival stream conditional on queue position. fill_probability is a function of the size queued ahead and the market-order depletion rate; it MUST lie in [0,1].

marks.description: Event sizes as a heavy-tailed (power-law) distribution. A distribution DECLARED gaussian while the sizes are heavy-tailed is refused (it would feed the wrong F to the risk kernel).

tail_index_hill.description: Hill estimator of the Pareto tail index alpha. Small alpha (< ~4) is a genuinely heavy tail.

lob_signals.description: LOB micro-signals shaped as the LIQUIDITY input the vol-surface / FTP layer consumes. kyle_lambda is the price impact per unit signed volume (>=0 for an adverse-selection book); effective_volume and signed_flow_hurst feed market_instruments.liquidity_premium(volume, regime_hurst, base_bps) BY REFERENCE.

consumes_interface.description: Signature hint for the consumer, e.g. 'market_instruments.liquidity_premium(volume, regime_hurst, base_bps)'.

risk_distribution_F.description: The marks distribution F exposed for the RAROC risk(F, kernel, reference, horizon) interface (economic-prophet risk_measures). A heavy-tailed marks F feeds the LPM/ES lenses; family 'empirical' carries loss-side samples for LossDistribution. Same shape as the memory-mesh MemoryRegimeCharacterization risk_distribution_F, reused BY REFERENCE.

receipt.description: Proof-artifact-spine receipt: a SHA-256 hash-chain link. Scope note: SHA-256 is the FIPS-180-4 algorithm; this is NOT a claim of FIPS-140 cryptographic-module validation.
